question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated position as CCP General Secretary, supported by anti-corruption drives that have removed potential rivals from senior party and military posts, drives the 95.5% trader consensus against removal before the end of 2026. No successor has been designated, and earlier norms of generational turnover were set aside after his third term, positioning the 21st Party Congress in 2027 as the probable venue for extending his leadership rather than a handover. Ongoing public appearances and policy continuity through mid-2026 signal stable elite alignment. Even with such high implied probability, abrupt health developments, major economic disruptions, or unforeseen divisions within party or military institutions could still shift outcomes before year-end.

question: Will Gavin Newsom win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
description:

eventMetadata.context_description: The Democratic presidential nomination for 2028 remains an open contest more than two years before primaries begin, with traders assigning comparable probabilities to several figures because no candidate has consolidated broad party support.
